text_blocks.snippet: To effectively treat gout symptoms, focus on both pain relief during flare-ups and long-term uric acid management. NSAIDs (like ibuprofen or naproxen) or colchicine can be used for immediate pain relief, while allopurinol or febuxostat can help lower uric acid levels in the long run. Additionally, lifestyle adjustments such as staying hydrated, avoiding alcohol (especially beer), and managing diet can significantly reduce the frequency and severity of gout attacks.
